summary: AstraZeneca PLC furnished a Form 6-K on 1 October 2026, equivalent to a US current report, disclosing a routine notification of admission of further securities to trading under the UK Public Offers and Admissions to Trading Regulations 2024 (PRM 1.6.4R). The filing covers 9,828 new ordinary shares of $0.25 each issued between 1 September and 30 September 2026 under the company's existing employee share schemes block admission dated 29 January 2021, raising total shares in issue to 1,551,053,289. Shares admitted on the London Stock Exchange Main Market are fully fungible with existing shares. No special-situation transaction, pricing, advisor, or board recommendation is involved; no risk-arb angle applies.
